title: Sustainability Director, APAC
description:
Vantage is seeking an experienced and strategic regional Sustainability Director to lead Vantage’s sustainability program in the APAC region. As the regional subject matter expert, this leader partners closely with cross-functional teams to align global strategy with local priorities, guide the integration of sustainability into major development and operational decisions, and support key stakeholder engagement. The Director will shape and drive regional sustainability strategy that aligns and enables regional business strategy. The Director will work closely with the Global Sustainability Center of Excellence (COE) who serves to support and enable regional implementation of sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Essential Job Functions
  
  
:
  
  
Advise and partner with APAC functional and regional executives to embed sustainability into business operations and drive transformational change.
  
  
Serve as the region’s sustainability subject matter expert (SME), guiding cross-functional partners across site selection, design, construction, procurement, and operations.
  
  
Align with the Global Sustainability team to integrate global strategy with regional priorities and contribute regional insights to global strategic development.
  
  
Work with the Global Sustainability COE to set regional sustainability goals, develop roadmaps, and localize global initiatives to fit market conditions, regulation, customer needs, and community expectations.
  
  
Advise regional leadership on sustainability-related risks, including regulatory, climate, water, social responsibility, innovation, reputational, and greenwashing risks, and help shape mitigation plans.
  
  
Collaborate with Public Policy to shape and support policy frameworks aligned with the company’s sustainability strategy across the region.
  
  
Support regional Public Policy and Communications in engaging communities, local government, and NGOs on environmental and social sustainability topics.
  
  
Represent Vantage’s sustainability efforts in regional customer engagements, industry forums, and thought-leadership platforms.
  
  
Partner with Sales and Commercial teams to develop sustainability-related sales enablement materials and support customer RFP responses, audits, and strategic sustainability discussions.
  
  
Proactively engage external stakeholders—including customers, investors, suppliers, community partners, and industry groups—to advance sustainability objectives and strengthen Vantage’s reputation.
  
  
Collaborate with the regional Sustainability Engineer to lead implementation of regional sustainability programs, performance improvement initiatives, and impact-reduction efforts.
  
  
Support sustainability risk and opportunity assessments for new market entry and expansion
  
  
Support development of regional and site-specific sustainability communication materials for customers, communities, and public stakeholders.
  
  
Support regional implementation of a sustainable supply chain engagement strategy
  
  
Support Global Sustainability COE with regional data collection and verify data quality for global sustainability reporting, disclosure, and assurance requirements.
  
  
Lead sustainability training, capability-building efforts, and awareness initiatives across regional teams with support from the Global Sustainability COE.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
:
  
  
10+ years of experience in corporate sustainability, environmental strategy, ESG, or related fields, with demonstrated impact in complex, multinational organizations.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Sustainability, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  
  
Experience in the data center, energy, infrastructure, or technology sector, particularly with large-scale development projects preferred but not required.
  
  
Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional initiatives across technical and non-technical teams, including engineering, construction, operations, procurement, commercial, and public policy.
  
  
Experience integrating sustainability into large capital projects (infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, real estate, or data centers).
  
  
Experience engaging directly with customers on sustainability topics (e.g., RFP responses, audits, strategic sustainability discussions).
  
  
Vantage is committed to being a workplace of inclusion, equity, respect and acceptance. We celebrate diversity and intentionally seek out opportunities to learn from one another’s experience.
  
  
Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

title: Research Fellow (Coral Climate Resilience)
description:
The Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) at Nanyang Technological University conducts research on climate and environmental change, with a strong focus on Southeast Asia. The Coral Reef Eco-Geomorphology Group studies tropical coral reef biodiversity, ecological function and resilience using field ecology and quantitative analysis.

  

We seek a Research Fellow in Coral Climate Resilience for an initial 12-month appointment, with potential extension subject to project needs and funding. The Fellow will investigate coral reef biodiversity, macroecological patterns and responses to marine heatwaves, bleaching and environmental stressors across Southeast Asia.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead research and publications on coral reef ecology, biodiversity, climate-change impacts and ecosystem resilience.
* Analyse large regional benthic and environmental datasets to identify patterns and drivers of change.
* Develop robust statistical and predictive approaches, including multivariate, hierarchical or Bayesian modelling.
* Plan and conduct regional scientific-diving fieldwork and collaborate with local research partners.
* Assess coral bleaching, reef-community dynamics and ecological indicators of vulnerability and recovery.
Lead manuscripts, reports and presentations; contribute to mentoring, data quality and collaborative group activities.  

  

**Job Requirements:**

* PhD in marine biology, ecology, evolutionary biology, environmental science or a related discipline.
* Strong publication record for career stage in coral reef ecology, macroecology, climate-change biology or related fields.
* Experience with coral reef field ecology, biodiversity surveys and interpretation of benthic or reef-community data.
* Advanced Open Water or equivalent diving qualification; scientific diving, Divemaster and first aid/CPR/O2 training are advantageous.
* Strong quantitative skills in R/Python and experience analysing large ecological or environmental datasets.
* Experience with multivariate, hierarchical, Bayesian, spatial or predictive modelling is highly desirable.
Excellent scientific writing, independent research and collaboration skills; willingness to undertake regional fieldwork.  

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

-------------------

* Collating and reviewing annual project progress reports, audits and monitoring of project milestones;

* Collating and processing project-level submission of claims in accordance with approved project scope and budget;

* Coordinating and maintaining regular communications with MCCS research project teams and other stakeholders;

* Coordinating use of SJINML facilities and agency test-bedding sites by MCCS researchers, and conduct landscape scans of Singapore’s marine research domain

* Organising and assisting workshops, seminars and related activities for relevant research collaborations, communications and outreach activities;

The successful candidate will need to be proactive and work independently and be comfortable to engage and interact with a wide range of local stakeholders including researchers, government agencies, and interest groups. Candidates will be required to be savvy with digital communication tools.

The successful applicant will also be expected to support the day-to-day operations related to the MCCS programme and research collaborations and/or activities at SJINML. This position will be based at both St. John’s Island National Marine Lab (at St. John’s Island) and the Coastal & Marine branch of NParks at the Singapore Botanic Gardens.

----------------

* Bachelor's Degree (or higher) in Life Sciences, Marine Biology, Environmental Management, Mass Communication, Finance, Accountancy or related discipline
* At least 2 years of working experience (preferably in a comparable role providing administrative/scientific project management support)
* Possess strong verbal and written communication skills
* Must have good organisation skills, able to multitask and manage tight timelines

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Applications (MS Word, Excel and Powerpoint).

* Basic knowledge of video, photo editing will be an added advantage

At SLR Consulting, we are problem solvers, innovators, and trusted advisors helping shape sustainable solutions worldwide. SLR comprises over 5,000+ staff across our global regions, with 35+ Practices covering Engineering & Design, Planning & Assessment Environmental Sciences, Earth Sciences and Advisory Services. * Act as a trusted advisor to clients, building long-term relationships and providing strategic environmental and sustainability advice.
* Develop and execute growth initiatives for the Singapore practice, while supporting broader business development opportunities across the Southeast Asian market.
* Identify, pursue and secure new business opportunities, leading proposals, tenders and client engagement activities.
* Mentor, coach and develop team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, safety and continuous professional growth.
* Manage project resources, workloads and priorities to ensure successful project delivery and effective utilisation of the team.
* Collaborate with regional and global technical specialists to deliver multidisciplinary solutions and expand service offerings for clients.
Represent the business externally through industry engagement, professional networks, conferences and client forums, strengthening the company's profile in Singapore and Southeast Asia.

* Degree qualification in Environmental Science, Marine Biology, Freshwater Ecology, Hydrobiology, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline, with postgraduate qualifications highly regarded.
* Extensive environmental consulting experience, including significant experience delivering aquatic ecology, marine science or related environmental projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing technical teams, including mentoring, coaching, performance management and recruitment.
* Strong technical expertise in one or more relevant disciplines including freshwater ecology, marine ecology, aquatic ecosystems, water quality or environmental assessment.
* Proven project management capability, including project planning, commercial management, budgeting, quality assurance and risk management.
* Experience developing and maintaining trusted client relationships across government, infrastructure, energy, resources, industrial or development sectors.
* Demonstrated success in business development, including proposal preparation, opportunity identification and work winning.
* Experience delivering EIAs, ESIAs and projects aligned with international standards such as IFC Performance Standards would be highly regarded.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence clients, stakeholders and multidisciplinary project teams.
Experience working within Singapore and/or Southeast Asia, with an understanding of regional environmental regulatory frameworks and market dynamics.  

  

**Our Benefits**

We are proud of our unique culture where we work together to collaborate on projects to get the best possible outcome for our clients. **[What the role is]**

Sustainability is integral to Singapore’s long-term growth strategy and economic resilience. At the same time, the global environment for climate action is becoming more complex. Governments, businesses and financial institutions will need to remain nimble, responding to evolving climate-related risks while capturing new economic and investment opportunities.
  
  
Against this backdrop, the MAS Sustainability Group plays an important role to support FIs in enabling the regional low carbon transition needs:
  
  
i) Energy Transition – supporting financing solutions that enable Asia’s shift towards lower-carbon energy systems, while taking into account energy security, access and affordability;
  
ii) Adaptation and Resilience – developing and scaling financing solutions to mobilise capital for the region’s climate- and nature-related resilience needs; and
  
iii) Carbon markets – supporting financial institutions in building capabilities and participating across the carbon market value chain, from project financing and risk mitigation to carbon credit trading.
  
  
You will be part of a central team responsible for developing and implementing strategies and initiatives across these areas. Working closely with relevant departments across MAS as well as government and industry partners, you will contribute to efforts to strengthen Singapore’s position as a leading climate and resilience financing centre.

**[What you will be working on]**

In this role, you will:

  
  

* Support the Sustainability Group (SG) in key projects aimed at catalysing financing for Asia’s low-carbon transition. The precise portfolio will be determined based on team priorities and the successful candidate’s experience. Areas of work could include:
  + Carbon Markets : working with other government agencies and industry partners on whole-of-economy strategies to grow Singapore as a carbon services and trading hub, as well as initiatives to enable the financial sector to capture opportunities arising from Singapore and regional carbon markets.
  + Adaption and resilience Financing . working with industry and other government agencies to develop and scale financing approaches for regional adaptation and resilience needs.
* Support account management on entities that MAS has key relationships with. This includes support on brief inputs for strategic meetings, assessments of KPIs and administrative processing of grants during annual reviews.
* Contribute to cross-MAS sustainability initiatives. This could include assessing developments in Singapore’s sustainable finance ecosystem and markets, contributing to MAS sustainability-related publications, and supporting engagements with international experts and advisory panels.

**[What we are looking for]**

* Relevant work experience in the financial sector is preferred.
* Knowledge of carbon markets, and adaptation and resilience is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to write clearly and synthesise messages
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to positively influence internal and external stakeholders
* Strong project management skills and able to lead organization-wide projects involving multiple stakeholders
* A good team player who is proactive and motivated
  

  

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. This is a 1-year contract.
  
  
All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

title: Global Director of Impact & Knowledge Management
description:
### **ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS**

New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change.  
  
We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY**

The Global Impact Director & Knowledge Management is the champion of New Energy Nexus’ ambition to be a true learning organization. They will lead the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning function at New Energy Nexus (NEX) that tracks, highlights, and strengthens the impact of the NEX network. The role owns NEX Global Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) framework, collaborates with the leadership to refine and maintain global Theory of Change (TOC), is the organization’s leading subject matter expert on disciplined TOC development and evaluations and supports country offices, programs, and initiatives to align their work with the overarching NEX global MEL framework. It supports the network to keep a common strategic direction and demonstrate its collective impact to funders, partners, and the wider clean energy entrepreneurship ecosystem.

NEX already has a strong Global MEL framework, impact indicators and supporting systems in place. The Director will be responsible for:

* Overseeing the implementation of the global framework across the network, providing strategic guidance and hands-on support to chapter and program.
* Continuously strengthening, refining and adapting the framework as NEX’s programs, geographies, partnerships and strategic priorities evolve.

The Director will support country teams and global programs by making impact work practical and useful with: clear definitions, light-touch templates, and practical coaching, plus visible proof that the data they collect shapes decisions, wins funding, and improves programs.

The role works in close partnership with the Strategy, Development and Communications teams.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

### **Global Impact Strategy, Theory of Change & MEL (40%)**

* Leads the development and implementation of NEX's global monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) framework, translating NEX’s Theory of change (TOC) into measurable outcomes and learning practices, while embedding justice, equity, diversity and inclusion (JEDI) principles throughout.
* Refine and update the standardized global impact indicators and data standards for collection, reporting, and management as needed.
* Lead design and implementation of MEL related policies, processes and practices across the organization in collaboration with Impact staff across the network.
* Actively contribute to the design of multi-country proposals and programs by developing and implementing log frames and MEL plans with clear indicators and learning loops.
* Actively participate in country and global strategy discussions from the outset, working closely with leadership to shape, review, and assess strategic priorities and ensure alignment with NEX’s Theory of Change, impact goals and JEDI commitments.
* Manage global impact databases and produce regular reports for the board, NEX leadership, funders, and external audiences as needed.
* Co-lead the annual Global Impact Report project with communications team

### **Chapter/Country Office Support & Capacity Building (30%)**

* Give chapters, program partners, and the fundraising team technical guidance on TOC, log frames, and indicators as needed.
* Strengthen staff capacity to understand and perform MEL related activities through training, building and maintaining global MEL toolkit of templates, guidelines, and best practices and facilitating cross learning sessions.
* Work with chapters to ensure alignment of chapter TOCs and MEL plans with the global framework while respecting local context.
* Lead and facilitate monthly Impact Guild meetings and an annual in-person convening to share best practices and insights.
* Provide 1:1 advisory support to chapter impact leads on MEL related topics.

### **Knowledge Management, Data Architecture & Impact Reporting (30%)**

* As a champion of NEX as a learning organization by embedding learning into its culture and collective capabilities, and turning network-wide impact data into insights on trends, gaps, and opportunities that inform program and product strategy.
* Lead the organization-wide knowledge management structure, data systems, and AI strategy for the purposes of MEL, program design, and stakeholder management, ensuring information on program participants, partners, funders, investors etc can be connected and used across teams.
* Collaborate with teams to integrate knowledge management systems and various databases, ensuring information is accurate, accessible, well-organized, and actionable for informed decision-making.
* Oversee the governance, security, and responsible use of organizational data, including in AI-enabled knowledge tools.
* Own and manage the global impact database (currently Airtable), including structure, definitions, data privacy and quality standards, and bi-annual update cycles with chapters and partners.
* Leverage AI and integrate it into NEX's MEL systems to build efficiency and standardization in data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting, while protecting data privacy and quality.
* Work with Communications Team to make collecting stories and case studies, with informed consent, part of the Impact team’s routine data collection, and to share emerging insights early enough to shape external communications.
* Maintain one approved set of impact figures, and review external materials for accuracy and attribution before publication, so Communications, Development and leadership quote the same numbers and describe NEX’s contribution to policy and ecosystem change in the same way.

  
**Requirements**

**Professional Experience**

* A minimum eight plus years of experience in impact measurement and management, or monitoring evaluation and learning. At least 3 years experience in working in organizations focused on climate change, clean energy and/or entrepreneurship.
* Demonstrated experience developing and applying a theory of change, log frames, MEL plans, and outcome indicators, and turning them into practical tools that others actually use.
* Experience managing impact databases and data quality processes (Airtable or a comparable platform), including data definitions, privacy standards, and consolidated reporting.
* Demonstrated experience applying equity-focused MEL approaches, including inclusive and participatory methods, disaggregated data analysis, and using evidence to identify and address inequities in program reach, participation, and outcomes.
* Proven ability to influence culture and collective behavior of a mission driven team to create enthusiasm for, collective ownership of and appreciation for a MEL as a core strategic competency
* Foundational knowledge of the climate, clean energy, and entrepreneurship support landscape, and willingness to engage in in-depth self-learning on any gaps.
* Demonstrated ability to stay ahead of emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in MEL and knowledge management, including the use of AI and digital tools to improve data analysis, organizational learning, and impact measurement.
* Experience supporting fundraising with impact evidence, such as contributing to complex, multi-country, or unrestricted proposals and funder reports.
* Experience training and coaching non-specialists in MEL topics and designing toolkits, templates, and learning sessions.
* Proven track record of effective internal and external relationship management.
* Knowledge Management: Demonstrated ability to design and maintain data systems, repositories, or dashboards that support organizational learning.
* Demonstrated experience of data management, analysis and reporting.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Experience supervising consultants.
* Ability to travel a few times in a year.
* Experience working in a global environment.
* Flexibility to accommodate meetings across difference times zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with recognized MEL frameworks and standards, and in-depth knowledge of how funders and impact investors use them.
* Experience leveraging AI and/or automation tools to build processes and systems for knowledge and data management.
* Experience building or adding structure to an impact function or network during a period of organizational transition.
* Experience working with accelerators, incubators, or other entrepreneurship support programs, and tracking post-program outcomes for startups and small businesses

  
**Benefits**  

### **BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION**

This is a full-time remote position. Relocation assistance is not available for this role and compensation is competitive for the market the candidate is based in. Applicable benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays and insurance will depend on the location of the selected candidate.

### **TO APPLY, TIMELINE, AND PROCESS**

* Submit your resume, cover letter and responses to our application questions.
* Click the “Apply” button below to begin your application.
* Interview process: Qualified applicants will participate in a series of interviews via Zoom. There will be 2-3 rounds of interviews.
* Accommodation: If you require accommodations during the interview process, please contact us with your request.

New Energy Nexus is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants or employees because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression of an otherwise qualified individual, or membership in any other class protected by applicable law. New Energy Nexus hires and promotes individuals on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled. We strongly encourage diverse applicants to apply.

title: Senior Environmental Consultant - Singapore
description:
About SLR Consulting & the Role
  
  
At SLR Consulting, we are problem solvers, innovators, and trusted advisors helping shape sustainable solutions worldwide. SLR comprises over 5,000+ staff across our global regions, with 35+ Practices covering Engineering & Design, Planning & Assessment Environmental Sciences, Earth Sciences and Advisory Services. In the Asia Pacific region (SLRAPAC), SLR has 1,200+ employees located throughout 24 offices.
  
  
At the heart of SLR is a collaborative 'One Team' approach, a supportive and accessible workplace culture, and opportunities to work alongside industry leaders while making a real impact.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior Environmental Consultant to join our team in Singapore as we continue to grow following Hydrobiology's integration into SLR. You'll join the same highly regarded local team, now backed by SLR's global network of environmental specialists, multidisciplinary expertise, and expanded technical capability.
  
  
The Senior Environmental Consultant is a postgraduate-level position reporting directly to the Team Manager. The role requires at least 5 years of professional consulting experience, with a strong focus on providing technical leadership and support to the Ecology and Biodiversity Management Team Manager and other senior staff. Key responsibilities include ensuring technical excellence in scientific data analysis, field surveys, project design, tender and report preparation, project management, and business development.
  
  
A significant proportion of our project work is undertaken in remote and challenging environments throughout Singapore and overseas. As such, this role will involve regular fieldwork, including travel and extended periods working in remote locations, typically for durations of less than one month. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, adaptable and keen to develop their technical skills within a collaborative team environment.
  
  
Main Tasks and Responsibilities
  
  
**Including, but not limited to:**  
Deliver environmental studies such as Environmental Baseline Studies (EBS), Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA), Environmental Management and Monitoring Plan (EMMP), Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD), Acquisition Due Diligence, Climate Change Studies, and Critical Habitat Assessments (CHA) projects.
  
  
Undertake scientific data collection, collation, statistical analysis and GIS mapping across marine freshwater and terrestrial environments
  
  
Support and lead multiple projects and multi-disciplinary environmental scopes, ensuring high-quality standards across all project deliverables.
  
  
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including government agencies, NGOs, and industry associations in Singapore.
  
  
Collaborate with the business development team to expand SLR's presence in Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  
  
Participate in and support fieldwork locally and internationally, including in remote and challenging environments.
  
  
Contribute to business development, strategic growth initiatives, government and private sector tender opportunities, marketing activities, and client relationship management across Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  
  
Supervise, mentor, and support the professional development of junior staff through structured technical guidance, QA/QC review processes, field training, and project delivery support to improve team capability, utilisation, and technical consistency.
  
  
Support SLR’s HSEQ Integrated Management System, including company policies, procedures, and safe work practices.
  
  
Contribute to the development and enhancement of SLR’s technical service offerings, methodologies, workflows, and environmental consulting capabilities.
  
  
Skills and Experience
  
  
At least 5 years of professional consulting experience, with exceptional communication skills (both oral and written). This role requires the ability to communicate clearly and concisely with various levels of leadership.
  
  
Demonstrates leadership in project ownership, staff development, operational improvement, and strategic business growth initiatives.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of aquatic or coastal ecosystems, particularly mangroves, as well as other coastal eco systems such as seagrass, corals, and related flora and fauna.
  
  
Proficiency in quantitative ecological methods.
  
  
Project management experience is a plus, with attention to detail and strong verbal, analytical, and writing skills.
  
  
Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
Self-motivated, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science ora related field from an accredited institution.
  
  
Postgraduate qualification (Master’s or PhD) from an accredited institution.
  
  
Proficiency in languages spoken in the APAC region is a plus, but not a requirement.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
  
We are proud of our unique culture where we work together to collaborate on projects to get the best possible outcome for our clients. Whether you’re working in the office, from home or a mix of the two, we recognise that every person is different, and our benefits aim to ensure that we cater for all.
  
  
Next Steps
  
  
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted with gender diverse interview panels to the best of our ability. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
  
  
Unsolicited resumes from recruitment consultants will not be accepted. You must be part of the preferred supplier agreement list which is coordinated through our Talent Acquisition team.
  
  
Please send your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and interest to Jaden Pine-Murphy at
  
  
jaden.pine-murphy@slrconsulting.com
  
  
.
  
  
OUR EXPERIENCE DIFFERENTIATES US
  
  
FROM OUR COMPETITORS.
  
  
Hydrobiology is an environmental consulting company offering integrated services in the physical, biological and chemical processes of environmental systems. Our focus is technical excellence and high scientific expertise in our fields of work. We have been active in Southeast Asia since the organisation was first established in the early 2000s. Singapore is our first regional operations base in Asia.
  
  
Hydrobiology has a long history of undertaking projects throughout south east Asia. We have experience with the extensive geographic and rich cultural diversity of the region, and have a deep understanding of high rainfall tropical ecosystems.
  
  
We offer technical skills to a range of industry sectors including mining, oil & gas, ports and harbours, and other industrial developments of various types. We apply our skills to both marine and freshwater systems, including estuarine and marine flora and fauna ecology, habitat mapping, water and sediment quality monitoring, biomonitoring, ecotoxicology, river management and developing and implementing risk assessment frameworks.
  
  
Hydrobiology has offices in Singapore, Brazil, Papua New Guinea and Australia. Our projects span the globe. Our Singapore team work across this portfolio. We are not a mega-corporation where you will be one of thousands of employees. We all know each other, and we all work together. With us you will have the opportunity to work with and learn from technical leads within Singapore and across all our offices. Our company offers industry-leading professional development opportunities and a genuine career pathway as a professional scientist. Our project list includes many of the most challenging, and interesting, projects and expeditions around the world, many of which are world renowned and set the standard in environmental monitoring and impact assessment.
